_comment: M28.4.1 set_curve_float_keys soak-only. UCurveFloat is not in the inventory pipeline's logic-bearing set (PROJECT_INVENTORY_BRIEF.md §3), so the inspect harness's re-export phase emits zero .md and the inspect gate would always fail. Expanding inventory scope is a separate design decision; for M28.4.1 we keep inspect skipped via `skip_inspect: true` and rely on soak for the determinism signal. The soak gate validates byte-identity of the mutated scratch .uasset across 2 rounds — round 1 populates the empty Curve_BpxTestEmpty duplicate with a 2-point curve (0,0)/(1,100), round 2 element-wise compares and hits the idempotent skip. Exercises explicit-FName determinism on SetKeys (no FGuid drift since UCurveFloat has zero FGuid fields per the M28.4.0 research). Mirrors the M28.5.1 add_eqs_option soak recipe: source fixture empty, plan populates, round-2 replay validates determinism.
